hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';if(/appsettings.*\.json/i.test(f)){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'ask',permissionDecisionReason:'appsettings*.json holds the SQL connection string and other config - confirm this edit is intentional.'}}));}});"

m=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||'';console.log(/\.cs$/i.test(f)?1:0);});"); if [ "$m" = "1" ]; then out=$(dotnet build ShiftFlow.Web/ShiftFlow.Web.csproj --nologo -v q 2>&1); if echo "$out" | grep -qE 'error CS[0-9]'; then echo "$out" | grep -E 'error CS[0-9]'; exit 2; fi; fi
